name: Fire Keeper
quotes: Welcome to the bonfire, Unkindled One.
Touch the darkness within me.
Ashen One, hear my voice, still for me...
Farewell, Ashen One. Mayst thou thy peace discover.

name: Shrine Handmaid
quotes: Ashen One, what is thy pleasure?
Overbeck me with souls, and I shall provide thee with key and trinket.
A pleasure to do business, Unkindled One.

name: Blacksmith Andre
quotes: Prithee, be careful. I don't want to see my work squandered.
Overwork a weapon, and it'll break.
All smithing requires is a hammer, and an anvil, and some elbow grease.
Don't get yourself killed. My smithy's always open.

name: Greirat of the Undead Settlement
quotes: I'm only a thief, but I have my pride.
Goodbye, and stay safe. Don't go hollow on me.
Heavens, she was already dead...
If I don't make it back, well, you can have my ashes.

name: Siegward of Catarina
quotes: Long may the sun shine!
Hmm... Mmm... Oh, pardon me, I was absorbed in thought.
No! You should have waited! Well, it's too late now. I, Siegward of the Knights of Catarina, fight by your side!
To your valour, my sword, and our victory together. Long may the sun shine!

name: Unbreakable Patches
quotes: We're friends, aren't we? You and I?
Every age, it seems, is tainted by the greed of men.
Thought you could outsmart an onion?
You got me, fair and square. No hard feelings, eh?

name: Karla
quotes: Do not be afraid of the dark, my dear.
I am a creature of the dark. There is nothing to fear in what is natural.
Oh, are you back? You really are a strange one.
Humans are creatures of the dark. Thus, we find comfort in it.

name: Cornyx of the Great Swamp
quotes: Pyromancy is the art of casting fire.
Fire is a living thing. It must be treated with respect.
Welcome back. The swamp is ever-inviting.
May the flame guide thee.
